description: Showed the rule, named six hundred and the roof, and cursed Allen in the same breath as the winter.
name: James Burbage

description: Asked why, and said Christmas is set down for Richmond.
name: John Heminges

description: Looked at William and said only that the Shrew begins at two.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Active in Copied Cowley's Benvolio and corrected the cue
name: Richard Cowley

description: Said the reason would come by breakfast, and that he was not in the play.
name: William Shakespeare
